title: Zesty Smoky Moroccan Chicken Tagine
description: A malty and juicy Moroccan dish featuring hot smoked paprika, perfect for a weeknight dinner, this keto-friendly recipe uses a comal for cooking and incorporates mushimono-steam for added flavor.
instructions: Preheat the comal over medium-high heat to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together hot smoked paprika, salt, and black pepper.
Add the chicken to the bowl and toss to coat evenly with the spice mixture.
Heat the olive oil on the preheated comal and add the chopped onion, cooking until it is translucent.
Add the minced garlic and grated ginger to the comal and cook for 1 minute.
Add the chicken to the comal and cook until browned on all sides.
Add the chicken broth to the comal and bring to a boil, then reduce the heat to low and cover with a lid.
Steam the chicken using the mushimono-steam method for 20 minutes, or until the chicken is cooked through and the internal temperature reaches 165 degrees Fahrenheit.
Stir in the chopped parsley and serve hot.
